releases.name: v0.1.0 – Initial release
releases.body:
`opencode-tool-templates` 0.1.0 is the initial release. It renders Handlebars templates into another tool's arguments and calls that tool in one step, or assembles templates into text or files.

Requires OpenCode 2.3.2+.

## Tools

- `template_call` — render templates into another tool's arguments and call it.
- `template_build` — assemble a template object into text or write it to a file.

Both tools use the default `template` namespace and register in Code Mode by default. When Code Mode is unavailable, OpenCode exposes them directly as `template_call` and `template_build`.

## Highlights

- Template objects: `$inline`, `$file`, and flat `$parts` chains.
- `$params` on template objects, chains, and parts; top-level `params` shares   values across `template_call` arguments.
- `$type` conversion to string, number, boolean, or JSON.
- `$separator` and `$skipEmpty` for chains.
- `template_call` target allow/deny, self-target denial, and input validation through Effect Schema, Standard Schema, or JSON Schema.
- `renderOnly` previews rendered arguments without calling the target.
- `template_build` text mode returns the assembled text; file mode writes it and returns `path`, `bytes`, and `parts` in `output` without returning the text.
- Path allowlists, `read`/`edit`/`external_directory` permissions, symlink and hard-link checks, and write safety for `template_build`.
- Bundled `SKILL.md` skill and user documentation.

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-tool-templates
```

Or from GitHub:

```sh
opencode plugin add github:finnseefly/opencode-tool-templates
```

Run `opencode reload` after installation, then ask the agent to call `template_call` or `template_build`.

**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-tool-templates/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md)

**Docs:** [README](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-tool-templates#readme) · [Tool reference](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-tool-templates/blob/v0.1.0/docs/reference.md) · [Limitations](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-tool-templates/blob/v0.1.0/docs/limitations.md)
